assets.author: LingZhenWu
assets.changes: Resized proportionally to at most 960×720; encoded as WebP; no generative editing.

coordinates.kind: approximate destination center; not a surveyed camera location

assets.sourceDescription: ​於2008年12月5日動土，耗資15億元，佔地3.4公頃，總面積超過10公頃。此中心以「禪定」為概念，整體規劃分成演藝廳、展覽館、藝術教育中心、數位圖書館等四棟主建築。建築的最大特色在於運用了大量的斜柱設計，並搭配Low-E玻璃降低冷熱傳導，節能減碳的同時也塑造現代簡潔線條的藝術美感；其外觀的大型漏斗建築體在夜間更會披上炫麗的彩色燈光，吸引眾人的注意，成為大高雄文化新地標。

facts.zh-TW: 2012年啟用，結合表演、展覽與藝術圖書館。薄膜天棚如懸浮熱氣球，是廣場的特色。
facts.en: Opened in 2012, this center combines performances, exhibitions and an arts library. Balloon-like membrane canopies are a distinctive feature of its plaza.

assets.author: WEI, WAN-CHEN（魏琬臻）
assets.changes: Resized proportionally and encoded as WebP; no generative alteration.
assets.sourceDescription: Pier-2 Art Center, located within Basin No. 3 in the Port of Kaohsiung, was built in 1973 as a general warehouse at the port. In 2000, this space, which is full of experimental possibilities, was discovered when the authorities were looking for a place for the National Day fireworks display. Passionate artists and local cultural workers integrated this unique, offshore and open space for art with the resources of the Council for Cultural Affairs’ idle space reutilization program and opened a new era of creation for the Pier-2 Art Center. Under the vigorous management of Kaohsiung Pier-2 Art Development Association and Shu-Te University’s Workshop for Developing Local Arts, Pier-2 Art Center has become a location for experimental creations and a development center for craft innovations in southern Taiwan. This art space is characterized as an avant-garde, experimental, innovative and international art platform in Kaohsiung. It also records the pulse of the life development history in Kaohsiung and the heart of a new Kaohsiung. This is the spirit of revitalizing Pier-2 Art Center as well as a new page for Kaohsiung’s culture and arts.
